responsibility: Main translation engine from analyzed GNAT trees to GCC trees and functions. It owns global access to GNAT node tables, per-function translation state, statement-group construction, elaboration procedure tracking, operation-code mapping, and large portions of Ada statement/expression/subprogram lowering, including thunk construction for dispatching and ABI adjustments, making it the central code-generation pass of gigi before generic GCC gimplification and optimization.
